explanation: The unfair 0-1 polynomial conjecture: if P and Q are monic with nonnegative real coefficients and PQ has all coefficients in {0,1}, then so do P and Q. IsZeroOne (nonzero coefficients equal 1) correctly encodes "coefficients in {0,1}". The question post reports computational verification up to degree 32, and an answer extends it to degree 66. The statement is faithful and open.
